backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining types and functions for distraction logging, activity switching, session management, app categorization, and burnout score calculation with persistent data structures.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: updating application name from 'Focus Tracker' to 'Focus Guardian' in index.html and Layout.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files describing component purposes, page functionality, hooks, and removed/simplified features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with updated title and meta description referencing 'Focus Guardian' as a productivity and focus monitoring application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with protected and public routes, theme provider, and toast notifications for all application pages.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Card component displaying individual achievement badges with image, title, description, unlock status, date, and progress bar.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Gallery component rendering grid of achievement badges with share functionality and export button, showing unlock progress statistics.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen blocking overlay requiring 25-minute productive session completion, displaying countdown timer, progress bar, and rotating productivity tips every 30 seconds.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutScoreCard: Displays the current burnout score with visual indicators (icon, color, progress bar) based on fatigue level (low/medium/high). Shows loading skeleton when data is being fetched.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutTrendsCha: Renders a line chart showing burnout score trends over the last 10 sessions with reference lines at thresholds (30, 60). Displays empty state when no session data exists.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Bottom-right notification that appears when burnout reaches medium threshold (30+), suggesting desk recovery breaks. Dismissible with smooth animations and reappears if burnout increases by 10+ points.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component displaying a numbered list of personalized daily recommendations to improve focus. Uses lightbulb icon and muted background styling.
frontend/src/components/DistractionLogMo: Modal dialog for manually logging distractions with fields for source name, category (productive/distracting/neutral), type (social media/work app/etc), and optional notes. Handles form submission and reset.
frontend/src/components/DistractionTrend: Line chart showing average distractions per session over the last 7 days, grouped by date. Displays empty state when insufficient data is available.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Bottom-right notification that appears when frequent tab switching is detected (shows switch count in last 2 minutes). Dismissible with smooth entrance/exit animations.
frontend/src/components/DistractiveConte: Full-page lock screen displayed when focus session violation limit is exceeded, showing remaining time with progress bar and motivational message. Uses lock icon and countdown timer.
Wrapper component that applies grayscale filter to distractive content during focus sessions when violation limit is exceeded. Shows centered warning overlay with countdown timer.
frontend/src/components/DistructiveVisit: Displays a dismissible warning alert at the bottom-right of the screen when users visit distractive sites, with three escalating warning levels (gentle reminder, focus check-in, final warning) before a focus lock activates.
frontend/src/components/DurationAnalysis: Shows a card with a pie chart visualizing session duration distribution (sustained focus, brief browsing, habit checking) and lists habitual distractions detected from short, repeated visits.
frontend/src/components/FocusLockOverlay: Renders a full-screen overlay with a lock icon, countdown timer, and progress bar when focus lock is active, explaining the reason for the lock and providing supportive messaging.
frontend/src/components/FocusSessionSumm: Displays a summary card after a focus session showing duration, distraction count, and a calculated focus score (0-100) with performance feedback and visual progress bar.
Shows a card displaying the user's consecutive days of completed focus sessions with milestone messages and a flame icon to gamify streak maintenance.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Applies a progressive grayscale filter overlay when burnout reaches high levels (level 2+), with intensity increasing proportionally to burnout index without blocking user interactions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with sticky header, navigation menu, profile dropdown with Internet Identity integration, and quick action buttons for desk recovery and walk breaks.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying a single metric with title, value, icon, and optional trend indicator showing increase or decrease from previous period.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Card component for displaying behavioral patterns with title, description, trend text, and visual styling differentiated by positive (green) or negative (amber) type.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Displays a periodic report with time period selector (week/month), export functionality, and grids of positive patterns and areas for improvement using PatternCard components.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Displays an overall productivity score (0-100) with a circular progress indicator, color-coded labels (Excellent/Good/Fair/Needs Improvement), and contextual feedback messages.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityTren: Renders a line chart showing weekly productivity trend data with focus scores over time using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Authentication guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to login and shows a loading spinner during Internet Identity initialization.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Displays a pie chart showing the breakdown of restorative vs. non-restorative break time using break analytics data.
frontend/src/components/SessionHistoryTa: Renders a table of past focus sessions with date, duration, distractions count, switches count, and color-coded score badges.
Modal dialog that prompts users to categorize their site visit as either productive or distractive when returning to the app.
frontend/src/components/TransitionMatrix: Displays the top 10 most frequent app-to-app transitions with visual intensity based on frequency, built from activity switch data.
frontend/src/components/TransitionPatter: Shows common interruption patterns (repeated activity transitions occurring 3+ times) in a card layout with arrow indicators.
frontend/src/components/ValidationMetric: Displays detailed real-time switching metrics including total switches, per-minute/per-hour rates, score breakdown formula, and a timestamped history table for system validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Provides a static list of 6 achievements (focus streak, deep work, distraction shield, etc.) with unlock status and progress, plus a function to copy achievement text to clipboard for sharing.
Simulates random application switching activity every 8 seconds, persists state to localStorage, and calculates switching metrics (per minute/hour) for demo purposes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActivityTransition: Records application transitions to the backend actor, fetches activity switches via query, and analyzes them to identify top repeated interruption patterns (3+ occurrences).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend canister actor using React Query, switching between authenticated and anonymous actors based on Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Manages application categorization (productive/distracting/neutral) with a default list of 15 apps, syncs categories to backend via actor, and initializes from backend data or defaults on mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Implements progressive warning system that blocks the screen after 2 warning dismissals, requiring a 25-minute productive session (low switching, not away) to unblock, with state persisted to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Returns hardcoded break analytics with 45 minutes restorative and 15 minutes non-restorative time, calculating percentages for display.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for desk recovery or walk breaks, tracking start/end times and formatting remaining time, with backend recording removed (old method no longer exists).
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Controls breathing exercise animation phases (inhale 4s, hold 4s, exhale 6s, rest 2s) with corresponding scale values for visual feedback when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Calculates burnout index (0-100) based on switching frequency and distraction score, categorizes into 3 levels (low/medium/high), persists to localStorage, and manages warning dismissal with re-trigger logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutScore.ts: Fetches current session stats or recent summaries to calculate burnout score from focus ratio minus switch/distraction penalties, categorizing into low/medium/high levels.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Returns mock dashboard metrics including focus time, distraction time, productivity score, burnout trend data, and recommendations since backend methods no longer exist.
Manages distraction logging with modal state, persists distraction count to localStorage, and calls backend actor to log distractions with source, category, type, and description.
frontend/src/hooks/useDistractionWarning: Manages progressive warning levels (0-3) based on destructive visit count with localStorage persistence, dismissal tracking, and automatic warning escalation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDurationAnalysis.t: Analyzes distraction logs and session summaries to classify sessions by duration (sustained focus, brief browsing, habit checking) and identifies habitual distractions with frequency counts.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusLock.ts: Implements escalating focus lock mechanism with countdown timer based on destructive visit count (5-60 minutes), persists lock state to localStorage, and provides formatted time display.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Monitors browser tab switching and window focus events to calculate distraction metrics including switch count, switches per minute/hour, time away, and switching history without recording personal data.
Manages Pomodoro-style focus session timer with work/break modes, pause/resume functionality, countdown logic, and localStorage persistence for timer state.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusSessionViolat: Tracks route navigation violations during focus sessions, triggers grayscale mode after threshold violations, and manages violation count with localStorage persistence (backend recording removed).
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusStatistics.ts: Calculates focus statistics from session summaries including focus streak (consecutive days with sessions), total focus time, productive visit ratio based on distractions, and a 7-day weekly trend of burnout scores.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Provides a simple timer hook that counts seconds when active and formats the duration as MM:SS.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching backend data including session summaries, distraction logs, activity switches, frequent distractions, current session stats, and app categories with retry logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative productivity patterns (consistent sessions, break timing, distractions, context switching, late-night work) with loading state based on time period selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionHistory.ts: Aggregates session summaries, top distractions, and distraction logs from queries, sorting sessions by recency and providing the 10 most recent sessions.
Tracks site visits as productive or distractive using localStorage and page visibility API, showing a prompt after 5+ seconds away and maintaining a destructive visit count.
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, progress calculation, and audio alert on completion; backend recording has been removed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm, supportive color palette for light and dark modes including primary, secondary, accent, and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Centralized copy/text constants for the app including dashboard messages, burnout warnings, blocking screens, break benefits, and focus guardian warning levels.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Displays the achievements page with a header and the AchievementsGallery component showing focus milestones and productivity wins.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Manages application/website categorization as productive, distracting, or neutral with add, edit, and delete functionality organized by category.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard showing hero section, quick action cards for starting focus sessions and viewing history, burnout score, metrics, and transition patterns.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Guided breathing exercise page with animated breathing circle, timer controls, and instructional cards for mindful desk recovery breaks.
frontend/src/pages/FocusSession.tsx: Focus session timer page with preset/custom work durations, break management, distraction logging, activity transitions, and session summary functionality.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring dashboard displaying current app, category, switch counts, switches per minute/hour, time away, and distraction score metrics.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication, displays app features (track focus, prevent burnout, build habits), and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page that displays the PeriodicReport component for viewing behavioral patterns and productivity insights.
frontend/src/pages/SessionHistory.tsx: Session history page displaying completed focus sessions, distraction trends, burnout trends, duration analysis, transition matrix, and top distractions with analytics charts and tables.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page allowing users to set and track break durations (5-60 minutes) with play/pause/reset controls and progress visualization.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application, ContextSwitch, FocusSession, FocusSessionViolation, and FocusSessionState interfaces.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended border radius, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting the renaming from 'Focus Tracker' to 'Focus Guardian' with completed features and pending request to update APP_NAME constant.
